name: Droid Sans 后备体
description: Droid Sans Fallback is a sans-serif typeface designed by Steve Matteson for Ascender Corporation as part of the Droid font family, originally commissioned by Google for the Android operating system. It was released in 2007. The primary purpose of the 'Fallback' variant is to provide extensive character coverage, particularly for East Asian languages (Chinese, Japanese, Korean), within the same visual style as Droid Sans. This makes it a functional 'fallback' font for user interfaces and electronic communication, ensuring text is displayed even when the primary font lacks the necessary glyphs. Its design is a humanist sans-serif, prioritizing clarity and readability on screens. The font is distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
